rules.document: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E), 27 January 2026, in force 1 April 2026)
rules.exact_text: All existing solid waste dumpsites or garbage vulnerable points to be geographically mapped and assessed for accumulation of solid waste by 31 October 2026 in urban areas and rural areas. This shall be done by the concerned local body in their jurisdiction.

rules.document: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E), 27 January 2026, in force 1 April 2026)
rules.exact_text: All Urban Local bodies shall arrange for door to door collection of segregated solid waste composed of wet waste, dry waste, sanitary waste and special care waste, from all households including slums and informal settlements, commercial, institutional and other non-residential premises, multi-storey buildings, large commercial complexes, malls, housing complexes, etc., on their own or through designated third party agency.

rules.document: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E), 27 January 2026, in force 1 April 2026)
rules.exact_text: All local bodies shall direct waste generators not to litter i.e throw or dispose of any waste such as paper, water bottles, liquor bottles, soft drink cans, tetra packs, fruit peel, wrappers, etc., or burn or bury waste on streets, open public spaces, drains, waste bodies

rules.document: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E), 27 January 2026, in force 1 April 2026)
rules.exact_text: The State Pollution Control Board or the Pollution Control Committee shall impose Environmental Compensation based upon polluter pays principle, on persons who are not complying with the provisions of these rules, as per guidelines notified by the Central Pollution Control Board including for indiscriminate dumping of solid waste by local authorities.

rules.document: CPCB Guidelines on Dust Mitigation Measures in Handling Construction Material and C&D Wastes (CUPS/89/2017-18, November 2017)
rules.clause: Dust control measures - Storage of Construction material and C&D wastes
rules.exact_text: All areas for storing C&D wastes / construction material to be demarcated and preferably barricaded particularly those materials that have potential to be dust borne.

rules.document: CPCB Guidelines on Dust Mitigation Measures in Handling Construction Material and C&D Wastes (CUPS/89/2017-18, November 2017)
rules.clause: Dust control measures - Storage, iii(a) Sand/ gravel
rules.exact_text: Sand and other fine aggregates be stored in demarcated areas and given a covering.

rules.document: CPCB Guidelines on Dust Mitigation Measures in Handling Construction Material and C&D Wastes (CUPS/89/2017-18, November 2017)
rules.clause: Dust control measures - Storage, ii(c) On-site
rules.exact_text: Sites of demolition activities to be cordoned off and adequate measures to reduce dispersal of dust beyond site limits.

rules.document: CPCB Guidelines on Dust Mitigation Measures in Handling Construction Material and C&D Wastes (CUPS/89/2017-18, November 2017)
rules.clause: Dust control measures at site - construction / demolition / renovation activity, (i)
rules.exact_text: Raise barricade along the perimeter depending on the nature of adjoining regions.
